# `Q-2-18` — Unclosed Strikeout

> A `~~struck-through~~` run opens with `~~` but no closing `~~`
> appears before the end of the block.

## What this means

Double-tilde strikeout (`~~text~~`) must be balanced inside the
same block. This error fires when an opening `~~` appears
without a matching close.

## Why this happens

A typo, an unfinished edit, or — rarely — a literal `~~` left in
the text by accident.

## How to fix

Add the closing `~~` at the intended end.

## Example

```markdown
~~
```
